mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25 percentage points over the next month, investors anticipate higher future inflation, which leads to a discounting premium on equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 5 trading days.
regime_hint: Rising short-term interest rate surprise in a neutral inflation regime
failure_condition: Over a 30-day window, the 5-day ahead SPX returns are not statistically different from the prior 5-day window (t-test p > 0.1); or FEDFUNDS movement is not statistically significant (Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS for three consecutive months reduces the real discount rate, increasing the present value of expected corporate profits and thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter (60 trading days).
failure_condition: Quarterly SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the prior quarter's average (t-test p > 0.05); or the 3-month FEDFUNDS decline is not confirmed by a break below the prior 3-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (labor market tightness) accompanied by a simultaneous drop in UNRATE (unemployment rate) signals a tight labor market, which raises wage growth expectations and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In a tight labor market regime, the 20-day forward return is not statistically positive (p > 0.1); or the PAYEMS/UNRATE cross is not statistically significant (Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (retail sales) unexpectedly exceeds its 12-month moving average by 10%, it indicates strong consumer demand momentum that persists into the next month, pushing up earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the following 5 days.
failure_condition: Over 30 days, the 5-day ahead returns are not significantly higher than the prior 5-day window (p > 0.1); or the HOUST breakout is not confirmed by a follow-up month of elevated earnings surprises.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) by more than 5% in two consecutive months suggests weakening supply-side capacity, which amplifies demand pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: Early stage of supply shock or contraction
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is not statistically negative (p > 0.1); or INDPRO contraction is not associated with elevated SPX volatility or negative realized skew over the window.

mechanism_narrative: During a sudden spike in CPIAUCSL (CPI YoY) above 3% in a single month, investors anticipate higher future inflation and preemptively discount future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the prior 60-day average (p > 0.1); or the CPI spike is not followed by persistent bearish sentiment (e.g., VIX > 20).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls by more than 0.5 percentage points in three consecutive months while PAYEMS remains flat, it indicates a structural decline in labor market slack, which reduces wage growth expectations and is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < (lag(UNRATE) - 0.5) and lag(PAYEMS) <= (current PAYEMS) + 1 and lag(PAYEMS) > (current PAYEMS) - 1
regime_hint: Structural weakening in labor market slack
failure_condition: In regimes with stable wage growth, the 5-day forward return is not statistically negative (p > 0.1); or the UNRATE/PAYEMS cross is not robust across multiple rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDPC1 (GDP personal consumption) by at least 2% followed by a month of elevated PAYEMS (> 110,000) suggests resilient consumer demand and corporate earnings optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter (60 days).
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > (lag(GDPC1) + 2) and lag(PAYEMS) < (current PAYEMS) + 110 and current PAYEMS > 110,000
regime_hint: Resilient demand cycle in a low-volatility environment
failure_condition: Quarterly SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior quarter (p > 0.05); or the GDPC1/PAYEMS pattern is not accompanied by a rise in earnings surprise frequency.
